story.title: A son of Bomet. A lawyer. A Senator.
story.p1: From Ndamichonik Primary to Tenwek High, then law at the University of Nairobi, Hillary Sigei built his career as an advocate before Bomet sent him to the Senate in 2022.
story.p2: There he chairs the Justice, Legal Affairs and Human Rights Committee, and has carried the Tea (Amendment) Bill through the Senate for small-scale growers.
